submitted.rationale: EQE rose steadily with Sb fraction: 0.0031% at Sb 0.28, 0.021% at 0.52, 0.058% at 0.72 and a high of 0.076% at 0.83 (index 26). It then fell to 0.056% at 0.85. XRD suggests rutile CrSbO4 is the main phase from 0.72 to 0.86. A secondary Sb-oxide phase (peaks at Q≈2.05 and 2.14) grows strongly toward 0.86, which may be why EQE drops past index 26.
